contentText:
The Pixel Watch 5 with a white band.

The Google Pixel Watch 5 is discounted by $60 during Amazon’s October sale, with the 41mm version on sale for $334.99, and the 45mm version for $364.99. The latest version of Google’s smartwatch rolled out alongside the Pixel 11 phones in August with improved GPS, gesture controls, and offline Gemini, although we had mixed results ahead of its launch with Google’s AI assistant’s proactive notifications. It’s possible that it has gotten better since.

Google Pixel Watch 5

Where to Buy:

- $399.99 $334.99 at Amazon

- $399.99 $350 at Google

- $399.99 $350 at Best Buy

The discount here helps offset the Pixel Watch 5’s $50 price hike over the Pixel Watch 4, and is particularly notable for coming so soon after the watch released. While every one of its new health features wasn’t rolled out in time for our initial review, Google is continuing to expand the watch’s functionality.

Read our Pixel Watch 5 review .
